lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build organized for workbench use with two storeys visible.

**Requirements:**
- two storeys — **met**: level 0 base (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:-1,0,0;full) and level 1 base (piece:0,0,1;full) connected by snap:0,0,0;full
- bins on top — **met**: bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full on piece at q0,r0,level1 (upper storey)
- a drawer below — **met**: notch:0#-1,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) between bases at level 0 providing drawer storage below
- all edges capped — **met**: 12 solid caps applied by capOpenFaces plus jointBolt:0#-1,0#0 via lockJoints; check_build meshClash clear with no issues

**Summary:** Two-storey L-shaped base (2 cells on bottom, 1 on top) with full bin on upper level and notch drawer frame on lower level, all open faces capped and joints locked. Verified clear.
